ITEM 1 | Sliced orange-red carrot rounds, glossy with a light glaze, some slices caramelized and browned at edges, arranged in a cluster across the left-center of the plate, roughly 8 cm by 7 cm footprint, slices about 0.5 to 0.8 cm thick, holding their shape | 120
ITEM 2 | Browned, slightly crisp potato chunks with golden-brown surfaces and irregular cut edges, scattered at top center and right of the plate, each piece about 2 to 3 cm, firm and dry-looking | 90
ITEM 3 | Sliced cooked meat, medium-brown to pinkish-brown with darker seared edges, fibrous grain visible, cut into strips about 4 to 5 cm long and 1 cm thick, sitting in a cluster on the right-center of the plate | 85
ITEM 4 | Bright green leafy vegetable, wilted and slightly glossy, with some darker edges, piled in clumps near the top center and lower center, interspersed with the carrots and meat, footprint about 6 by 5 cm, thin leaves | 35
ITEM 5 | Small amount of thin, pale amber liquid sheen and light juices pooled in spots around the meat and potatoes, glossy and slightly oily | 5
